faq.question: How much does a project cost?
faq.answer: The guided estimate provides an indicative range. A final quote depends on the agreed scope, timeline and integrations.

faq.question: Will I own the source code?
faq.answer: Source code ownership and third-party licenses are defined in the service agreement. Transfer of agreed deliverables takes place after the agreed payments.

faq.question: Can you improve an existing website?
faq.answer: Yes. We can review the existing stack and discuss redesign, migration, performance or new features.

faq.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
faq.answer: Yes. Maintenance scope, response times and monthly costs are agreed separately.

guidance.question: Do I need a complete specification?
guidance.answer: No. A short description of your business, the problem and the intended users is a useful starting point. We can work together to define a first release and agree what is outside scope.

guidance.question: Can a project start small and expand later?
guidance.answer: Yes. We can define a focused first release, with a data model and integration approach suited to later expansion. Future work is scoped separately.

guidance.question: Can you connect tools we already use?
guidance.answer: We can evaluate existing APIs, export formats and access permissions, then propose an integration where technically feasible. Third-party subscriptions and restrictions are reviewed during scoping.

guidance.question: How do you approach AI reliability?
guidance.answer: We define permitted information sources, retrieval rules and an evaluation plan. Where decisions are sensitive, we design for human review instead of promising fully autonomous accuracy.

guidance.question: How do you approach privacy and access?
guidance.answer: We discuss what information the system needs, who can use it and which data must remain private. Authentication, role boundaries and retention are agreed according to the project.

guidance.question: Can we see progress before launch?
guidance.answer: We plan reviewable milestones and demonstrate agreed features as they become available, so feedback can be incorporated before release.

guidance.question: What happens after delivery?
guidance.answer: We agree on handover, deployment responsibilities and any maintenance separately, including documentation and third-party operating costs.
